messages:
Ana: Quick sync — are we aligned on the packaging for the Snow/DBX + vector-SI bundle for marketplace listing? Need coordinated launch plan with the hardware partner.
Marcus: We're aiming for a soft launch 3/20, public 4/5. Marketing assets mostly ready. Need final connector icon and supported versions list. @Tom can you confirm sample workload?
Tom: Sample workload is the 10k-doc FAQ + 1GB embeddings set. We'll add perf numbers for 512/2048 context. One thing: the installer needs a flag for KMS key id and an env var for telemetry opt-in.
Sam: Eng notes:
- connector package: `redwood-connector-snow-db-1.2.0.tgz`
- acceptance tests: run matrix (Snowflake 8.x, Databricks 13.x, Milvus 2.2)
- telemetry schema v2 — need schema review before marketplace submission

Can we get a 2-week engineering freeze window for final cert? :calendar:
Jen: Legal turnaround is ~7 business days for co-branded contract language and marketplace T&Cs. Also need: logos on a co-marketing addendum, sample press quote sign-off. I'll start drafting.
Marcus: OK. Marketing will need the approved quote by 3/25. Also, what about the joint announcement with HW partner? @Ana any constraints?
Ana: HW partner prefers announcement after hardware availability window (they release 4/1). They asked for a joint embargo to 4/5. Works with our public date. 
Tom: For SI bundle, let's include a `--enable-sherpa-hw-optim` flag and a README note about driver versions. I'll publish a draft installer and run the CI job: `ci/marketplace-packages/pack-and-validate`.
Marketplace Bot: Checklist update: packaging (in progress), legal (pending), marketing (in progress), eng-cert (pending). See run: https://ci.redwood.ai/pack/1732 :white_check_mark:
Sam: I'll post the telemetry schema PR by EOD. Also need an approval from QA on the smoke test script. @Tom can you assign a QA owner?
Tom: Assigned to Priya in the SI team. Priya will run the smoke tests 3/18-3/21.
Jen: I'll route the co-marketing addendum for signature once the final logos are attached. Please send assets to legal@redwood.ai.
Marcus: Great. Next sync Wed 3/13 10am PT. Agenda: final packaging, legal checklist, CI pass. 
Ana: Thanks all — keeping timeline tight but looks doable. :rocket:
